ai_summary.key_headline: USA's Dynamic Wing Combinations Face Direct Australian Physicality

united_states.philosophy: High intensity pressing, vertical transitions, and dynamic flank overloads.

australia.philosophy: Compact defensive organization, direct flank crosses, and set-piece targeting.

tactical_insights: Pulisic and Robinson will look to double-team Australia's right-back to create crossing opportunities.
Australia will rely on Harry Souttar's aerial presence to threaten on corners and set-piece opportunities.
The athletic battle between McKennie and Irvine will dictate who controls the second balls in midfield.
